title: GPT-4’s One-Dimensional Mapping of Morality: How the Accuracy of Country-Estimates Depends on Moral Domain
benchmark_measurement: The paper measures GPT-4's accuracy in predicting country-level moral opinions across 18 moral issues from the World Value Survey and European Value Study. It does not specifically measure anything related to faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not analyze aspects of religion, so there are no findings related to it. The introduction mentions 'religious affiliation' as a known source of bias in LLMs, citing other studies, but it is not a focus of this paper's investigation.
